title: The AI Grinch Won’t Steal Christmas, but Watch Next Year
title_zh: AI 格林奇偷不走耶誕節，但明年得當心
subtitle: AI 格林奇偷不走耶誕節，但明年得當心
author: Spencer Jakab

sentences.en: Anthropic’s IPO has turned into a bust.
sentences.zh: Anthropic 的 IPO 已經變成一場失敗。

sentences.en: Its shares slipped below the offering price on Tuesday and appear to be headed for more losses today.
sentences.zh: 它的股價週二跌破發行價，今天看起來還會繼續下跌。

sentences.en: The slide is poisoning the well for companies still hoping to raise money from a public that’s growing less optimistic about the earning power of artificial intelligence, including OpenAI.
sentences.zh: 這波跌勢正在破壞後來者的機會：包括 OpenAI 在內，仍希望向愈來愈不看好人工智慧獲利能力的大眾募資的公司，都受到影響。

sentences.en: As usual, it’ll be studied as a barometer of American consumers’ health.
sentences.zh: 一如往常，它會被拿來當作觀察美國消費者狀況的晴雨表。

sentences.en: High pump prices, rising interest rates and low sentiment notwithstanding, predictions of a decent holiday shopping season from the likes of the National Retail Federation should hold up.
sentences.zh: 儘管油價偏高、利率上升、消費情緒低迷，全國零售聯合會等機構對今年假期購物季仍算不錯的預測，應該還站得住腳。

sentences.en: Even more gut-wrenching stock-market selloffs like last Friday’s won’t change that because holiday spending plans are fairly locked-in.
sentences.zh: 即使再出現像上週五那樣令人揪心的股市拋售，也不會改變這一點，因為假期的消費計畫大致上已經鎖定。

sentences.en: Elon Musk won’t be skimping on gifts for his at least 14 children because SpaceX shares tumbled.
sentences.zh: 馬斯克不會因為 SpaceX 股價大跌，就在至少 14 個孩子的禮物上吝嗇。

sentences.en: Back in the mid-1980s, overall spending by households in the top quintile was around three times as much as the lowest quintile.
sentences.zh: 回溯到 1980 年代中期，最頂層五分之一家庭的整體支出，大約是最底層五分之一的三倍。

sentences.en: Recent anecdotes from retailers, hotel chains and airlines indicate that the mass-affluent have become even more important customers as poorer cohorts pull back.
sentences.zh: 零售商、連鎖飯店和航空公司最近的個案顯示，隨著較貧窮的群體縮手，中高資產族群已變成更重要的顧客。

sentences.en: Even if the data-center boom underpinning a chunk of U.S. economic growth doesn’t suffer, consumer spending could if confidence in what kind of returns those investments will produce takes a hit.
sentences.zh: 即使支撐美國一大部分經濟成長的資料中心熱潮沒有受損，只要人們對這些投資能帶來何種報酬的信心受到打擊，消費仍可能下滑。

sentences.en: Optimism over the AI boom is one reason why anemic consumer-confidence surveys have been so out of sync with overall spending, writes labor economist Gad Levanon, chief economist of the Burning Glass Institute.
sentences.zh: 勞動經濟學家、Burning Glass Institute 首席經濟學家 Gad Levanon 寫道，對 AI 熱潮的樂觀，是疲弱的消費者信心調查與整體支出如此不同步的原因之一。

sentences.en: But a bump to the spending of an affluent household emboldened by a jump in their stock-market wealth outweighs a slight pullback by a lower-income household.
sentences.zh: 但是，一個因股市財富躍升而更大膽消費的富裕家庭，其支出增加，會蓋過低收入家庭稍微縮手的影響。

sentences.en: This month’s choppiness in AI stock values arrived too late to ruin Christmas.
sentences.zh: 這個月 AI 股價的波動來得太晚，已破壞不了耶誕節。

sentences.en: The glow of Jensen Huang’s surprise return continued to fade, as investors turned to gnawing concerns around the AI build-out.
sentences.zh: 黃仁勳突然回歸所帶來的光環持續消退，投資人轉而關注圍繞 AI 擴建、揮之不去的疑慮。

sentences.en: The other stock squarely in investors’ focus, Anthropic, continued to languish beneath its listing price in premarket trade as shares fell a further 6%.
sentences.zh: 另一檔完全落在投資人焦點上的股票 Anthropic，盤前交易繼續在掛牌價下方低迷，股價再跌 6%。

vocab.usage: turn into a bust 變成一場失敗；a housing bust 房市崩盤（也可當形容詞 a bust deal）
vocab.example: The highly praised product launch turned into a bust.
vocab.example_zh: 那次備受讚譽的產品發表最後變成一場失敗。

vocab.usage: below the offering price 低於發行價；set the offering price 訂定發行價
vocab.example: The shares closed above the offering price on the first day.
vocab.example_zh: 這檔股票掛牌首日收在發行價上方。

vocab.zh: 破壞後來者的機會；先把水源搞髒
vocab.usage: poison the well for later companies 讓後來的公司更難募資或被信任
vocab.example: The scandal is poisoning the well for other firms in the industry.
vocab.example_zh: 這樁醜聞正在破壞同產業其他公司的機會。

vocab.usage: a barometer of consumers’ health 消費者狀況的晴雨表；a barometer of demand 需求指標
vocab.example: Retail sales are a key barometer of the economy.
vocab.example_zh: 零售銷售是經濟的重要晴雨表。

vocab.usage: high prices notwithstanding 儘管價格偏高；也可放在句首 Notwithstanding the risks,…
vocab.example: The plan went ahead, the high costs notwithstanding.
vocab.example_zh: 儘管成本很高，這項計畫還是繼續進行。

vocab.zh: 令人揪心的；劇烈難受的
vocab.usage: a gut-wrenching selloff 令人揪心的拋售；gut-wrenching losses 令人難受的虧損
vocab.example: Investors endured a gut-wrenching drop in the afternoon.
vocab.example_zh: 投資人在下午經歷了一輪令人揪心的下跌。

vocab.usage: won’t be skimping on gifts 不會在禮物上吝嗇；skimp on quality 在品質上偷工減料（skimp 的現在分詞）
vocab.example: The hotel is not skimping on staff during the busy season.
vocab.example_zh: 這家飯店在旺季並沒有在人手上吝嗇。

vocab.usage: the top quintile 最頂層的五分之一；the lowest quintile 最底層的五分之一
vocab.example: Income in the top quintile rose faster than in the others.
vocab.example_zh: 最頂層五分之一家庭的收入，成長速度快過其他組別。

vocab.usage: the mass-affluent 財富不錯但還不算最有錢的那群顧客；也可當形容詞 mass-affluent customers
vocab.example: Luxury brands are turning more attention to the mass-affluent.
vocab.example_zh: 精品品牌把更多注意力轉向中高資產族群。

vocab.usage: poorer cohorts 較貧窮的群體；age cohorts 不同年齡層（cohort 的複數）
vocab.example: Younger cohorts are more likely to shop online.
vocab.example_zh: 較年輕的群體更常在網路上購物。

vocab.usage: the boom underpinning growth 支撐成長的熱潮；underpin a recovery 支撐復甦（underpin 的現在分詞）
vocab.example: Strong exports are underpinning the country’s growth.
vocab.example_zh: 強勁的出口正支撐這個國家的成長。

vocab.usage: anemic consumer-confidence surveys 疲弱的消費者信心調查；anemic growth 疲弱的成長（美式拼法；英式 anaemic）
vocab.example: The recovery looks anemic compared with past cycles.
vocab.example_zh: 和以往的週期相比，這次復甦顯得疲弱。

vocab.usage: out of sync with spending 與支出不同步；fall out of sync 變得不一致
vocab.example: The survey results were out of sync with actual sales.
vocab.example_zh: 調查結果和實際銷售並不同步。

vocab.usage: emboldened by a jump in wealth 因財富躍升而更大膽；embolden someone to do 讓某人敢做某事
vocab.example: Emboldened by strong results, the firm raised its dividend.
vocab.example_zh: 受到亮眼成績鼓舞，這家公司提高了股利。

vocab.usage: A outweighs B A 的影響超過 B；the benefits outweigh the risks 好處大於風險
vocab.example: For many customers, the extra cost outweighs the convenience.
vocab.example_zh: 對許多顧客來說，額外的費用超過了便利。

vocab.usage: choppiness in stock values 股價的波動起伏；choppy markets 起伏不定的市場
vocab.example: The choppiness in prices made investors more cautious.
vocab.example_zh: 價格起伏不定，讓投資人變得更謹慎。

vocab.usage: gnawing concerns 揮之不去的疑慮；a gnawing doubt 一直存在的懷疑
vocab.example: There are gnawing concerns about the company’s debt.
vocab.example_zh: 外界對這家公司的債務一直有揮之不去的疑慮。

vocab.usage: languish beneath its listing price 在掛牌價下方低迷；languish in last place 一直墊底
vocab.example: The shares continue to languish below last year’s high.
vocab.example_zh: 這檔股票繼續在去年高點下方低迷。

vocab.usage: concerns around creditworthiness 對信用可靠度的疑慮；assess creditworthiness 評估信用狀況
vocab.example: Lenders are taking a closer look at the creditworthiness of borrowers.
vocab.example_zh: 放款機構正在更仔細檢視借款人的信用可靠度。

vocab.usage: lifted its guidance 上修財測；issued lower guidance 釋出較低的展望
vocab.example: The company raised its full-year guidance after strong sales.
vocab.example_zh: 這家公司在銷售強勁之後，上修了全年財測。
